titulo: Sydney teen taken to hospital after falling from moving bus on northern beaches
cuerpo: Transport for NSW, bus operator and Rail, Tram and Bus union investigate after incident on Monday evening Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Investigations are under way after a teenage girl fell from a moving double-decker bus on to a busy road in Sydney’s northern beaches. Emergency services were called to Manly Road at Seaforth on Monday evening after the teenager fell from the B-Line bus near the Spit Bridge. Continue reading...
